# Screen 198 · My record reviews

Mounted the shared typed reviewer worklist at its separate Doctor (demo.doctor) workspace and F1 scope. It uses the actor's assigned list, live active criteria, audited exact detail and a separately reviewed final request with GET-only recovery. Implemented grouped answers, server suggestions, comment guards and a snapshot view. The tested items below exclude that unexercised detail and submission path.

On real DEV, Doctor (demo.doctor) received the own empty list with include_reviewed false and true and 28 active criteria. Empty copy, criteria toggle, F1 from the criteria button with focus restore, and bilingual 250% in both themes passed. Exact references are in 198-journey.json and 198-199-api.json. Ordinary Nurse's independent sandbox own-list read returned 403. Final review request passed schema validation. Native traces contained no business writes or sampled detail reads. Mandatory build, 198-screen handbook coverage, TypeScript and 873 tests passed.

Limits: the reviewer had no assigned item. No claimed item detail, positive submission, live notification or human/editorial/translation review. A populated synthetic review fixture is still required.
